news.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
news.summary: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

news.title: Bitcoin hits block 961,632 as the controversial BIP-110 soft fork attempt begins
news.summary: The proposal has scant support from bitcoin miners and influential commentators have also voiced their opposition.

news.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
news.summary: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

news.title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
news.summary: The rule applies to transfers above $10,000 and smaller transactions flagged as risky by exchanges.

news.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
news.summary: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

news.title: Why trillion-dollar asset manager T. Rowe Price put memecoins in its crypto ETF
news.summary: The $1.9 trillion asset manager says excluding established memecoins on principle would undermine its active approach to crypto investing.

news.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
news.summary: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

news.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
news.summary: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

news.title: ‘This has been an emotionally difficult time’: My brother has cancer and my father is 94. How do I shoulder this responsibility?
news.summary: “My father placed his $600,000 Wisconsin home into a revocable trust, naming my brother as beneficiary.”

news.title: ‘I’m in my peak earning years’: I’m working beyond 70. Will that help increase my Social Security?
news.summary: “I plan to retire at the end of my 70th year and transition to Medicare.”

news.title: How can we minimize taxes in retirement with a $2.3 million nest egg — while buying homes in Florida and New England?
news.summary: Timing is everything when balancing retirement distributions and moving across state lines.

news.title: Don’t worry about what other people have saved for retirement. Here’s how to find your perfect number.
news.summary: Don’t compare your nest-egg balance to a number that doesn’t actually mean anything. Instead, do this calculation to see if you’re on track for retirement.

news.title: ‘I don’t wish to be cold-hearted’: My elderly relative can no longer care for himself. Am I wrong to leave his care to the state?
news.summary: “He has never been particularly generous or nurturing.”

news.title: I’m an unemployed software developer who is skeptical of AI. Can I still find a job in tech?
news.summary: “I was approached by one company who wants to use AI to dispatch ambulances.”

news.title: ‘My wife and I are both retired’: Do we dip into our $2.3 million fund to pay off our $300,000 mortgage at 2.9%?
news.summary: “Right now, we’re withdrawing about $100,000 a year from our investments.”
